posts.title: Molybdenum Quasi Phase-Only Masks Improve EUV Imaging (NYCU, TSMC)
posts.summary:
Researchers at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and TSMC published a technical paper titled “High contrast EUV imaging enabled by topological quasi phase-only masks.” Abstract Excerpt: “Here, we propose a paradigm shift in EUV PSM technology by introducing molybdenum (Mo)-based quasi phase-only masks (quasi-POMs) with high reflectivity and minimal absorption. Through rigorous electromagnetic simulations,... » read more
The post Molybdenum Quasi Phase-Only Masks Improve EUV Imaging (NYCU, TSMC) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: NYCU and TSMC researchers demonstrated that molybdenum-based quasi phase-only masks (quasi-POMs) significantly outperform conventional tantalum-based absorbers in EUV lithography.
The new mask technology provides up to 35% higher image contrast and a fivefold increase in the common focus window.
The implementation enables 12.5-nm half-pitch resolution for 0.33 NA EUV systems while reducing peak telecentricity error by 92%.

posts.title: Heterogeneous Memory Chiplets Accelerate Multi-Request LLM Inference (NUS)
posts.summary:
Researchers at the National University of Singapore published a technical paper titled “CHIPSMORE: Compute-in-Interconnect and -Memory Chiplets for Multi-Mode Multi-Request LLM Inference Acceleration.” Abstract Excerpt: “This paper presents CHIPSMORE, a multi-mode and multi-request LLM inference accelerator that integrates compute-in-interconnect and CIM to support both base-mode and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) inference under diverse workloads. CHIPSMORE employs... » read more
The post Heterogeneous Memory Chiplets Accelerate Multi-Request LLM Inference (NUS) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Researchers at the National University of Singapore developed CHIPSMORE, a multi-mode accelerator designed to handle diverse LLM inference workloads.
The architecture utilizes a heterogeneous mix of RRAM-based analog compute-in-memory and SRAM-based digital compute-in-memory.
A programmable Inter-PE computational network (IPCN) enables the system to support both base-mode and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) inference efficiently.

posts.title: Reducing HBM ECC Controller Overhead For AI Inference (RPI, IBM)
posts.summary:
Researchers at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and IBM T.J. Watson Research Center published a technical paper titled “REACH: Controller-Managed Long-Span ECC for HBM AI Inference.” Abstract Excerpt: “High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) cost motivates stronger controller protection that can support a wider range of device error rates.High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) cost motivates stronger controller protection that can support a... » read more
The post Reducing HBM ECC Controller Overhead For AI Inference (RPI, IBM) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: RPI and IBM researchers introduced REACH, a controller microarchitecture designed to reduce the overhead of error-correcting codes (ECC) in High-Bandwidth Memory.
The design leverages the read-dominated nature of LLM inference to aggregate spans for error correction while minimizing parity-update traffic during sparse writes.
By using inner codes for common errors and reserving long outer codes for known-erasure repair, the system maintains high reliability without the performance penalties of traditional long-span ECC.

posts.title: Characterizing Charge Components In TMD-based MOS Structures (imec, KU Leuven, ASM)
posts.summary:
Researchers at imec, KU Leuven, and ASM published a technical paper titled “Dissecting the transition metal dichalcogenides-based metal-oxide-semiconductor structures charge components.” Abstract Excerpt: “Different variable charges such as interface traps, oxide border traps, and mobile carriers can contribute to the total capacitance in metal oxide semiconductor (MOS) field-effect devices. This study aims to quantify these... » read more
The post Characterizing Charge Components In TMD-based MOS Structures (imec, KU Leuven, ASM) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: A collaborative study by imec, KU Leuven, and ASM provides a methodology to quantify charge components in transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD)-based MOS devices.
The research utilizes multi-frequency, multi-temperature capacitance-voltage scans combined with Hall measurements to isolate interface traps, oxide border traps, and mobile carriers.
This characterization is critical for advancing the reliability and performance of next-generation 2D material-based field-effect transistors.

posts.title: China unveils five-year NEV plan, targets 70% share of passenger-car sales by 2030
posts.summary:
China targets NEV shares of 70% for passenger-car sales and 40% for commercial-vehicle sales by 2030, alongside large-scale deployment of autonomous vehicles.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: China's 15th five-year plan targets a 70% NEV penetration rate for passenger cars and 40% for commercial vehicles by 2030.
The policy emphasizes the large-scale deployment of autonomous driving and vehicle-road-cloud integration in major urban centers.
The government intends to implement stricter oversight on production capacity and battery manufacturing to curb inefficient local investment.
The plan mandates that autonomous driving systems must demonstrate safety performance superior to human drivers to facilitate widespread commercialization.
